title: Final Energy Eigenvalues
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the energy eigenvalues for the Hamiltonian.

title: Ground State Wavefunction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct wavefunction for the ground state of the system.

title: Two-Particle Ground State Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the correct ground state energy for the two-particle system.

title: Perturbation Energy Correction
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the first-order correction to the ground state energy due to the perturbation.

title: Perturbation Wavefunction
description: Important Criteria: The student must write down the correct wavefunction for the ground state to lowest order in the perturbation.

title: Matrix Form of Hamiltonian
description: Optional Criteria: The student may present the Hamiltonian in matrix form to clarify the problem setup.

title: Completing the Square
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show the process of completing the square for the Hamiltonian.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the energy calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
